On an ordinary morning, Diane was taking her usual walk along a beach in Tasmania when something unusual caught her eye in the surf – a bottle rolling in on the waves.
Curious, she picked it up and discovered a note inside.
Determined to figure out what it said, Diane sought help from locals, including her brother, who had just returned from Chile with a Spanish dictionary.
Word by word, they struggled to piece together a rough translation: “Life has taught me that anything is possible.”
One evening, bored and looking for something fun to do, Erika wrote a note, sealed it in an empty bottle, and threw it overboard.
She once mentioned to her family that if someone did, she would love to meet them – maybe even walk together on the very beach where it landed.
Days turned into weeks, then months.
Each time she opened her inbox, her hope faded a little more.
